column1: # tools/suite-map.tsv - the changed-path -> suite map. THE MAP IS THE GATE.
# Format and row semantics: docs/coverage-map.md (the prose moved there, airhorn-m85h).
# A SUITE MAPS TO ITSELF AND NEEDS NO ROW (airhorn-xh81): a change to tests/x.test.mjs runs
# tests/x.test.mjs, and the map's job is only to place suites over OTHER files. Do not add a row
# that names nothing but itself - delete one you find. The single exception is
# tests/acceptance.mjs, which is not spelled *.test.* so its row is what makes it a suite at all
# (and it is explicit-only by design, airhorn-i8i).
# CONFLICT HERE? Do not hand-merge it (airhorn-tp3g, airhorn-fp5q). The map is a SET the gate unions at run
# time, so a collision is resolved by key, mechanically - with the merge BASE as the third file, so a row or
# comment block one side DELETED stays deleted instead of being put back (airhorn-famo):
#   git show :1:tools/suite-map.tsv > /tmp/base.tsv; git show :2:tools/suite-map.tsv > /tmp/ours.tsv; git show :3:tools/suite-map.tsv > /tmp/theirs.tsv
#   node tools/derive-coverage-contract.mjs   # the contract is DERIVED: regenerate it, never merge it
#   git add tools/suite-map.tsv .fleet/coverage-contract.json   # or the merge cannot continue (airhorn-nn8g)
# tools/gate.conf's SUITE_TIERS block has the SAME treatment (airhorn-09dr): union with
# `git config merge.suite-map-union.driver "node tools/merge-suite-map.mjs --driver %O %A %B"` makes git do the
# union for you (.gitattributes has the entry); the tool refuses a disagreement by name instead of choosing.
